title: How to get more social proof on your Meta Ads (for free)
description: How to get more social proof on your Meta Ads (for free)
transcript: Want more social proof on your meta ads for free? Then there's a setting you need to know about in your ad account. Go to advertising Settings, and in there, for most ad accounts, you'll see a setting called Combine Social Proof. And you want to make sure that this is turned on, because when it's turned on, meta will combine the social proof, the likes, the comments, the shares, the interactions across ads that are similar. So if you're running the same or similar ad creative across multiple copy variations, meta will combine them. If you're running the same offer with similar headlines but different creative variations, meta will combine them. What that means is that each ad that's put in front of your prospects will have a lot more social proof. And we know that is one of the factors that can help drive conversions.
